alexcrichton opened PR #14591 from alexcrichton:update-table-and-memory-types to bytecodealliance:main:

Previously MemoryType panicked and TableType erroneously accepted max > min. Instead of changing TableType to panic it felt best to instead change to a Result and propagate that everywhere. Table types now additionally verify that the maximum is indeed greater than the minimum.
